content.comment_body: Hello, The manufacturer installs a [product_name] 24RCEo (without display) and does not provide a backup or application. Since this [product_name] version doesn't have a display, how can I find the IP address to set up communication and retrieve an upload of the application?

Welcome to the forum. Refer to the attachment. Open a blank network project and click on "Go Online." After a short while, the software will show you the [product_name] modules along with their IP addresses.
Thanks for the quick response. I'll try this method when I have access to the machine, since I'm currently not at the company.
This is an English-language forum. Please write your future posts in English. Thank you.

I'm sorry for that. I knew the posts should be in English, but my browser automatically translated everything to Portuguese and I couldn't find a way to stop it. I'm now using Internet Explorer and everything is fine. I promise it won't happen again. Thank you.
Thank you very much. The solution worked perfectly, just as you described and showed.

analysis.insight_summary: The user was unsure how to locate the IP address of a version of [product_name] without a display in order to connect and upload an application. Another forum member explained how to use the 'Go Online' function in the software, which displays the IP address, and the user confirmed that the method worked smoothly.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants a straightforward method to discover the IP address of a [product_name] module without a display so they can configure it and upload software.
